entries.title: Numbers 20:1
segments: ¶Then the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there and was buried there.

entries.title: Numbers 20:2
segments: Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Numbers 20:3
segments: And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying: "If only we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!

entries.title: Numbers 20:4
segments: "Why have you brought up the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our animals should die here?

entries.title: Numbers 20:5
segments: "And why have you made us come up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? It [is] not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates; nor [is] there any water to drink."

entries.title: Numbers 20:6
segments: So Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

entries.title: Numbers 20:7
segments: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 20:8
segments: "Take the rod; you and your brother Aaron gather the congregation together. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it will yield its water; thus you shall bring water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their animals."

entries.title: Numbers 20:9
segments: So Moses took the rod from before the LORD as He commanded him.

entries.title: Numbers 20:10
segments: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock; and he said to them, "Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring water for you out of this rock?"

entries.title: Numbers 20:11
segments: Then Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their animals drank.

entries.title: Numbers 20:12
segments: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe Me, to hallow Me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."

entries.title: Numbers 20:13
segments: This [was] the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the LORD, and He was hallowed among them.

entries.title: Numbers 20:14
segments: ¶Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom. "Thus says your brother Israel: 'You know all the hardship that has befallen us,

entries.title: Numbers 20:15
segments: 'how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 20:16
segments: 'When we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent the Angel and brought us up out of Egypt; now here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.

entries.title: Numbers 20:17
segments: 'Please let us pass through your country. We will not pass through fields or vineyards, nor will we drink water from wells; we will go along the King's Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.'"

entries.title: Numbers 20:18
segments: Then Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through my [land], lest I come out against you with the sword."

entries.title: Numbers 20:19
segments: So the children of Israel said to him, "We will go by the Highway, and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; let me only pass through on foot, nothing [more]."

entries.title: Numbers 20:20
segments: Then he said, "You shall not pass through." So Edom came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.

entries.title: Numbers 20:21
segments: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.

entries.title: Numbers 20:22
segments: ¶Then the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 20:23
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying:

entries.title: Numbers 20:24
segments: "Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the water of Meribah.

entries.title: Numbers 20:25
segments: "Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

entries.title: Numbers 20:26
segments: "and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; for Aaron shall be gathered [to his people] and die there."

entries.title: Numbers 20:27
segments: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

entries.title: Numbers 20:28
segments: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

entries.title: Numbers 20:29
segments: Now when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, all the house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.
